name: Shaun Kirk
long_description:
The Undercurrent presents Shaun Kirk!

Hailing from the music-filled streets of Melbourne, Australia, Shaun Kirk is an award-winning blues and soul troubadour recognised for his exceptional talent as a born entertainer. His unique talent has not only earned him many accolades but also much praise from fellow artists, such as three-time Grammy Award Winner Fantastic Negrito, who has declared his show as One of the best one-man shows he’s ever seen!

Kirk's vocals exude a gritty, soulful depth that seems to transcend far beyond his years, with critics continually acclaiming him as one of the finest blues voices Australia has ever heard (Buzz Mag). Complementing his vocal artistry, Kirk's vintage guitar tones and raw grooves pay tribute to the timeless influences that have shaped his musical journey, resulting in a distinctive sound fast becoming his own.

Shaun’s musical journey has taken him to stages all over the world, where he's not only performed but consistently sold out shows, leaving audiences enthralled by his magnetic presence. From iconic festival stages like Bluesfest Byron Bay, where he's become a familiar name, to sharing the billing with legends like Robert Plant of Led Zeppelin, John Mayer, Paolo Nutini, John Butler Trio, and The Teskey Brothers; Kirk's artistic prowess is in esteemed company. This remarkable journey is a testament to Kirk's unmatched talent and ability to connect with audiences across genres and generations.

id: Bad Taste - Side Quest Album Release w/ Staff After Party-San Fran, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Bad Taste - Side Quest Album Release w/ Staff After Party
long_description:
Please join BAD TASTE this summer as they embark on a journey throughout Aotearoa. The duo composed of turntablist ALPHABETHEAD and lyricist YOUNG GHO$T are touring in support of SIDE QUEST, their upcoming debut album on vinyl! The album is a fantastical romp on horseback through a richly detailed, vinyl sampled Hip Hop landscape...

While working on their ‘serious’ album ‘BAD TASTE III’, the pair found themselves constantly distracted by a myriad of other musical pathways drawing them away from their main quest. Ghost would brush aside Alphie’s pre-chosen beats, preferring to pluck records straight from the shelf and create on the spot, fully embracing spontaneity and playfulness. Many of the verses were penned as the instrumentals took shape: stream-of-consciousness raps punctuated with surprising twists and turns. Fueled by millet porridge, fireball whisky and nature walks, SIDE QUEST is a love letter to distraction, imagination and letting curiosity, rather than prescription, be the guide.

The duo's previous work has been described as psychedelic hip hop, inspired in equal parts by MF Doom and King Crimson. These two influences still shine bright as guiding lights on this album, but this time Monty Python and Roger Dean are added to the brew. SIDE QUEST is the closest the duo have come to a concept album; the intent being cohesion; an ebbing and flowing, crate-digging, time travelling rap adventure. Every track is a new chapter, and amongst all the lyrical action, time is still taken to survey the vistas, break bread and pour potions.

To celebrate the release of this record, they’re travelling up and down the country, linking up with friends new and old to perform in some of their favourite places.

BAD TASTE are known for their energetic and theatrical live shows, with the combination of rapping and scratching forming a potent synergy. The pair has supported everyone from Odissee to Tamatha Paul, and they’ve performed at festivals such as Camp A Low Hum, Twisted Frequency, Welcome to Nowhere, Newtown Festival and Cuba Dupa.

These shows promise to be a delight to both the Hip Hop fan and the musically adventurous. BAD TASTE would love to see you! <3

ALPHABETHEAD is the musical project of David Morrison, a producer and turntablist based in Whanganui.

At any point in time Alphabethead finds himself adrift in the musical cosmos, somewhere between the constellations of Hip Hop, Electronica and Experimental Rock. At the age of 18 Morrison won the 2002 New Zealand DMC DJ Championship and this title sent him performing across the globe. Over the next twenty years he would go on to make albums as Alphabethead, and as one third of cult genre-shredders The All Seeing Hand. David also contributed production or turntable scratching for Home Brew, Tourettes, Benny Tones, Death & The Maiden, The Etymologists (featuring Richard Nunns and David Long (The Mutton Birds) and The Village Of The Idiots. His musical prowess has led to tours through Aotearoa, Australia, UK and China and performances at festivals like WOMAD, Splore, Laneway and Camp A Low Hum.

YOUNG GHO$T is a true compiler of the obscure and the obvious; leaving no stone unturned on his quest of sonic exploration. The London-born lyricist moved from the UK to Aotearoa in 2011, and in this time has forged a reputation as a fierce live performer. The scope of his work is broad, and he thrives in open minded musical environments, operating without prejudice. He is comfortable both on the mic and the decks and has performed at some of Aotearoa’s most prominent club nights and festivals, as well as helping to expand the growing bass music scene in Te Whanganui-a-Tara through his production company, Ghost Media. As of 2026, he has also joined Public Service Center, the capital’s newest nightlife venue, operating as a musical curator.

id: Mercury Fèng - 'HK Sunset City Baby' Listening Hour-Octo Listening Bar, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Mercury Fèng - 'HK Sunset City Baby' Listening Hour
long_description:
Celebrate Mercury Fèng's forthcoming EP 'HK Sunset City Baby' in style with a relaxed, intimate pre-release listening party at Octo Listening Bar. All are welcome :)

MF will play her EP through at 4 and again at 4:30pm. Stay for afters with an EP-inspired TVDiSKO dj set from 5pm.

/////////
Wellington, New Zealand, 2026: Chinese New Zealand musician and artist
Lucy 小凤 Beeler, aka Mercury Fèng, waits for her washing in the
Berhampore Laundrette. Between cycles, she daydreams, imagining
herself in another life, locking eyes with a wanted man inside Hong
Kong’s Chungking Mansions three decades earlier. Their encounters are
distant, but loaded with desire, until they finally draw closer after
sunset, on one of many rainy, neon-lit nights.

Simultaneously inward-looking and as expansive as the Victoria Harbour
skyline, Mercury Fèng’s HK Sunset City Baby is a soft-focus
exploration of romantic longing and the fleeting moments of connection
that feel like forever, expressed over six ethereal songs that explore
memories, dreams, the pain of distance, and the intricacies of
intimacy.

Set against glossy retrofuturistic synthesisers, floaty drum machines
and atmospheric guitars, Beeler transforms herself into her alter ego,
Mercury Fèng, a lost diva from Hong Kong’s cultural golden era.
Following the hazy, hypnagogic pop of her archive for humble stones
(2025) album, HK Sunset City Baby, made with support from Creative New
Zealand, marks a new stylistic milestone in her oeuvre. Due for
release on 28 November 2026, through World of Paint, on cassette and
digital formats. [Martyn Pepperell]

id: Cat Power The Greatest. On Tour.-The Opera House, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Cat Power The Greatest. On Tour.
long_description:
Twenty years on, The Greatest still sounds like midnight.

This summer, Cat Power returns to New Zealand for a run of special shows performing her seminal 2006 album The Greatest in full, alongside songs spanning one of the most singular catalogues in contemporary music.

Recorded in Memphis with members of the legendary Hi Rhythm section, The Greatest remains a defining statement from Marshall: smoky, soulful and heartbreakingly intimate. Featuring enduring tracks including “The Greatest”, “Living Proof” and “Lived in Bars”, the album cemented Cat Power as one of the most influential voices of her generation.

To mark the album’s 20th anniversary, these rare performances will revisit the record front to back, a chance to experience its quiet power, emotional depth and timeless beauty in the live setting it deserves.

Support for these shows will be Lawrence Arabia - the acclaimed musical project of Christchurch-born singer-songwriter James Milne, one of New Zealand’s most celebrated and influential contemporary artists. Across a career spanning nearly two decades, Milne has released a string of critically acclaimed albums, earning an APRA Silver Scroll for his song Apple Pie Bed, the inaugural Taite Music Prize, and multiple Aotearoa Music Awards.

There are few artists who can hold a room the way Cat Power can. Experience the magic of The Greatest and re-enter the orbit of the early millennium in these raw, hypnotic shows in November.

id: Marcellus Pittman-Meow Nui, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Marcellus Pittman
long_description:
ew DJs understand a dancefloor quite like Marcellus Pittman. A cornerstone of contemporary Detroit dance music, Pittman brings decades of experience, deep musical knowledge and an unmistakable sense of groove to Meow Nui on Friday 27 November.

A true master behind the decks, Pittman is known for sets that move effortlessly between rolling, low-slung house, high-tempo disco, raw techno, funk, post-punk and deeper late-night selections. His approach is instinctive and unpredictable, built around meticulous mixing and an ability to read a room and take it exactly where it needs to go.
Pittman first came to prominence alongside Theo Parrish on Essential Selections Volume 1 before becoming one quarter of the legendary Three Chairs, alongside Parrish, Kenny Dixon Jr. (Moodymann) and Rick Wilhite. He later founded his own Unirhythm imprint and released music through labels including Omar-S’ FXHE, while also collaborating as part of the T.O.M. Project and Rotating Assembly.

His productions carry the same raw, spacious and deeply human quality as his DJ sets, pairing tough drum programming with subtle, unexpected detail. It is a sound rooted firmly in Detroit while remaining completely his own.

From intimate basements to major clubs and festivals across the world, Marcellus Pittman has built a reputation as one of dance music’s most respected selectors. This is a rare chance to experience a true Detroit heavyweight on the Meow Nui system.

Support from Benny Salvador, one of Aotearoa’s most exciting young selectors, blending house, techno, electro, disco-funk, dub, boogie and beyond.

Don’t miss your chance to be in the room.


Support from: Benny Salvador, one of the most exciting young talents in the Aotearoa dance music underground, he is a DJ, multi-instrumentalist, producer and radio show host. Benny has won over audiences throughout New Zealand with eclectic, dancefloor friendly selections that find the common threads between house, techno, electro, disco-funk, dub, boogie and beyond.

long_description:
Having lit up stages for years as both a keys master, soul man and member of Aotearoa legends Fly My Pretties, get ready as the good reverend of R&B and soothsayer of soul LOUIS TM hits the Rogue stage with his band for an irresistible mix of timeless soul classics and bold modern interpretations that’ll have everyone up and dancing!!

Music from 9:30pm - FREE ENTRY

Koha for the band encouraged!

id: Bizarre-esque-The Undercurrent, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Bizarre-esque
long_description:
The Undercurrent presents Bizarre-Esque!

To all the kings & queens, the magnificent in-betweens, humanoids, misfits, and creatures of every conceivable persuasion, come and embrace the world of Bizarre-Esque!

Under the direction of composer and pianist Karim Efremov, a collective of musical oddities invites you into a world where jazz flirts with musical theatre, rock dances within fusion, and avant-garde refuses to behave.

Expect theatrical absurdity, mischievous improvisation, moments of exquisite intimacy, and glorious eruptions of organised chaos.

So, my darling creatures, abandon your inhibitions, surrender your expectations, and prepare to indulge in an evening of musical eccentricity.

Come witness the living bizarre!

Friday Nov 27
Doors 7pm
Music 7:30pm
$20 ($10 unwaged)

Tickets available online and at the door!

Snacks, a range of refreshing drinks, tea & coffee, and of course...books available for purchase!

We’ll see you there ☆

id: Ari Leason-Hilltop Private House Concerts, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Ari Leason
long_description:
Gate opens 7pm Music Starts 7.30pm

Ari Leason is a singer/songwriter born and raised in Ōtaki known for her soulful blend of indie folk and intimate storytelling which shines through her album ‘Hello Darling’. Honest, vulnerable, and deeply authentic, Ari brings songs shaped by activism, travel, and a coming-of-age journey that resonates long after the last note.
Ari has opened for greats such as Julia Dean, Anika Moa, and Jenny Mitchell, and has played at many folk events too. Come along for a wonderful night.

Come along and enjoy this great gig in our special space, up close and personal.
These are private house concerts, not for profit, supporting our dedicated musicians. Visit www.hilltophouseconcerts.co.nz to reserve a seat. Suggested donation $30. Email confirmation will include address and details. Teas, Coffee and Snacks provided. You're welcome to bring anything you'd like to eat or drink.
Parking available in the Coupon zones of Upland Rd & Glasgow St free after 6pm weekdays, and free all through the weekends. The Wilson Carpark at the top of the Cable Car charges 24/7.
